item.title: vCAC 6.1 build out to distributed model: Clustered vCAC Appliances
item.description: With the release of vCAC 6.1 there have been some great improvements in the setup of the clustered vCAC appliances - none of the previous copying of configuration files between appliances - just a simple wizard to do it all for you. In my opinion this is superb.

item.title: vCAC 6.0/6.1 build out to distributed model: Deploy the Identity Appliance
item.description: SSO is a fundamental requirement when deploying vCAC, whether for a distributed or simple installation. This walk through goes through the deployment and configuration of the vCAC Identity Appliance, which provides a stand alone SSO instance for vCAC.
